tools.name: track_package
tools.description: Current status, estimated delivery and full scan history of one tracking number. A carrier that needs the recipient's postcode answers postcode_required until zipcode is passed.

tools.name: track_packages
tools.description: Track up to 100 numbers at once (at most 35 per carrier). Each entry has a result or an error; one bad number never fails the rest. Without sign-in only the first number is tracked; past a daily limit the remaining entries come back with error code auth_required or rate_limited. zipcode applies to e

tools.name: get_rates
tools.description: Shipping prices for one parcel between two postal codes from USPS, UPS and FedEx, cheapest first, with delivery days and surcharges. Each quote names its source and rateType (retail, list, or a postage reseller's price). Quotes only: nothing is bought and no label is made. Sources that can't quote c

tools.name: list_carriers
tools.description: Carrier ids that can be passed as carrier; zipcode lists the ones that need the recipient's postcode.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "track_package" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Current status, estimated delivery and full scan history of one tracking number." → after: "Current status, estimated delivery and full scan history of one tracking number. A carrier that needs the recipient's postcode answers postcode_required until zipcode is passed."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
